name: <!DOCTYPE html> page skeleton
summary: Minimal valid HTML5 page with language, charset, viewport and title.
example:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>Page</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="style.css">
</head>
<body>
  <script src="app.js" defer></script>
</body>
</html>
notes: Without the viewport meta tag, phones render at ~980px and zoom out.

name: <meta name="description">
summary: Short summary shown by search engines (120-160 characters).
example: <meta name="description" content="Handmade coffee in Lisbon since 2019.">

name: Open Graph tags
summary: Title, description and image used when a link is shared.
example:
<meta property="og:title" content="Bean There">
<meta property="og:description" content="Handmade coffee.">
<meta property="og:image" content="https://example.com/og.jpg">
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">

name: <header> <nav> <main> <footer>
summary: Landmark elements; screen readers jump between them. One <main> per page.
example:
Home
...
© 2026

name: <section> vs <article> vs <div>
summary: <section>: a themed group with a heading. <article>: self-contained (post, card). <div>: no meaning, for styling only.
example:
Menu

...

name: <a href>
summary: Link. External links opening a new tab should use rel="noopener".
example: Docs Contact Email Call

name: <button>
summary: Use for actions (not navigation). type="button" stops it from submitting a form.
example: <button type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="menu">Menu</button>

summary: Always set alt (empty alt="" for decorative), width/height to avoid layout shift, loading="lazy" below the fold.

name: <picture> responsive images
summary: Serve smaller files to phones and modern formats where supported.

name: <form> <label> <input>
summary: Every input needs a label. Use the right type for the right phone keyboard.
example:
<form action="/subscribe" method="post">
  <label for="email">Email</label>
  <input id="email" name="email" type="email" autocomplete="email" required>
  <button type="submit">Subscribe</button>
</form>
notes: type=email/tel/number/url give phones the right keyboard; autocomplete fills it in.

name: <select> <textarea>
summary: Dropdown and multi-line text input.
example:
<label for="size">Size</label>
<select id="size" name="size"><option>Small</option><option selected>Medium</option></select>
<label for="msg">Message</label>
<textarea id="msg" rows="4"></textarea>

name: <details> <summary>
summary: Native accordion; works without JavaScript and is keyboard accessible.
example:
Do you deliver?

Yes, within Lisbon.

name: <dialog>
summary: Native modal. showModal() traps focus and adds a backdrop; Esc closes it.
example: Saved!

name: <video> <audio>
summary: Media with controls; muted+playsinline required for autoplay on phones.
example: <video src="clip.mp4" poster="poster.jpg" controls playsinline muted loop></video>

name: <iframe> embeds
summary: Embed maps/videos; give a title and lazy-load.
example: <iframe src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/ID" title="Intro video" loading="lazy" allowfullscreen></iframe>

name: <table>
summary: Tabular data only; use <th scope> and a <caption>.
example:
Opening hours
Mon8-18

name: <ul> <ol> <li>
summary: Lists. Navigation menus are usually a <ul> of links.
example:
• Home
  • About

name: Skip link
summary: Lets keyboard users jump past the header.
example: Skip to content /* .skip{position:absolute;left:-999px} .skip:focus{left:1rem;top:1rem} */

name: aria-label / aria-expanded
summary: Name icon-only controls; announce open/closed state.
example: <button aria-label="Open menu" aria-expanded="false"><svg aria-hidden="true">...</svg></button>
notes: Prefer native elements; ARIA only fills gaps.

name: <link rel=preconnect / preload>
summary: Speed up fonts and critical assets.
example:
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preload" href="hero.jpg" as="image">

name: <script defer / type=module>
summary: defer runs after parsing without blocking; modules are deferred by default.
example:
<script src="app.js" defer></script>
<script type="module" src="main.js"></script>

name: favicon and theme-color
summary: Tab icon and the phone browser's toolbar colour.
example:
<link rel="icon" href="favicon.svg" type="image/svg+xml">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#0E1117">

name: Web app manifest
summary: Makes a site installable on a phone home screen.
example:
<link rel="manifest" href="manifest.json">
// manifest.json: {"name":"Bean There","short_name":"Bean","start_url":"/","display":"standalone","icons":[{"src":"icon-512.png","sizes":"512x512","type":"image/png"}]}

name: Custom properties (CSS variables)
summary: Define design tokens once on :root; override per theme or component.
example:
:root { --bg: #fff; --text: #111; --accent: #c45; --radius: 12px; }
body { background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); }

name: box-sizing
summary: Make width include padding and border; set globally.
example: *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }

name: Flexbox
summary: One-dimensional layout: rows or columns, alignment, wrapping.
example:
.row { display: flex; gap: 1rem; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.grow { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
notes: min-width:0 lets flex children shrink and ellipsize text.

name: Grid
summary: Two-dimensional layout. auto-fit + minmax gives responsive cards without media queries.
example: .cards { display: grid; gap: 1rem; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)); }

name: grid-template-areas
summary: Name page regions and rearrange them per breakpoint.
example:
.page { display:grid; grid-template-areas: "head" "main" "foot"; }
@media (min-width: 900px) { .page { grid-template-areas: "head head" "side main" "foot foot"; grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr; } }

name: Media queries (mobile first)
summary: Write phone styles first, add min-width queries for larger screens.

name: Container queries
summary: Style a component by its container's width instead of the screen's.
example:
.card-wrap { container-type: inline-size; }
@container (min-width: 400px) { .card { display: flex; } }

name: clamp() fluid type
summary: Font sizes that scale with the viewport within limits.
example: h1 { font-size: clamp(2rem, 1rem + 4vw, 4rem); }

name: Responsive images in CSS
summary: Keep images inside their box.
example:
img, video { max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
.cover { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; object-fit: cover; }

name: aspect-ratio
summary: Reserve space for media and cards.
example: .thumb { aspect-ratio: 1; object-fit: cover; }

name: position: sticky
summary: Header that sticks to the top while scrolling.
example: header { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 10; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 85%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); }

name: Centering
summary: Center anything.
example: .center { display: grid; place-items: center; min-height: 100dvh; }

name: 100vh vs 100dvh
summary: dvh follows the phone's visible viewport as browser bars show/hide.
example: .screen { min-height: 100dvh; }

name: Transitions
summary: Animate state changes; prefer transform and opacity (cheap on phones).
example:
.btn { transition: transform .15s ease, background-color .2s; }
.btn:active { transform: scale(.97); }

name: @keyframes animation
summary: Looping or one-off animations.
example:
@keyframes fade-up { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
.reveal { animation: fade-up .5s ease both; }

name: prefers-reduced-motion
summary: Respect users who turn animations off.
example: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: .01ms !important; transition-duration: .01ms !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; } }

name: prefers-color-scheme (dark mode)
summary: Default to the system theme; toggle with a data attribute.

name: :focus-visible
summary: Visible focus ring for keyboard users only.
example: a:focus-visible, button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

name: :hover on touch screens
summary: Phones have no hover; wrap hover styles so they do not stick after a tap.
example: @media (hover: hover) { .card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } }

name: Tap targets
summary: Make touch targets at least 44x44px.
example: .icon-btn { min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; }

name: Text overflow / ellipsis
summary: One-line truncation, or clamp to N lines.
example:
.one-line { white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.two-lines { display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; }

name: Fonts with font-display
summary: Avoid invisible text while web fonts load.
example:
@font-face { font-family: "Inter"; src: url(inter.woff2) format("woff2"); font-display: swap; }
body { font-family: "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif; }

name: Shadows and radius
summary: Soft elevation.
example: .card { border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .06), 0 8px 24px rgb(0 0 0 / .08); }

name: Gradients
summary: Linear, radial and text gradients.
example:
.hero { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1f4a, #f800f8); }
.title { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f80, #f0f); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent; }

name: color-mix()
summary: Mix colours for tints and translucent surfaces.
example: .chip { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 15%, transparent); }

name: :has() parent selector
summary: Style a parent based on its children.
example:
.field:has(input:invalid) label { color: crimson; }
body:has(dialog[open]) { overflow: hidden; }

name: scroll-snap
summary: Swipeable carousels with no JavaScript.
example:
.carousel { display: flex; gap: 1rem; overflow-x: auto; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory; }
.carousel > * { flex: 0 0 85%; scroll-snap-align: center; }

name: scroll-behavior / scroll-margin
summary: Smooth anchor scrolling that does not hide under a sticky header.
example:
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
section { scroll-margin-top: 80px; }

name: z-index and stacking
summary: z-index only works on positioned elements; transforms create new stacking contexts.
example: .menu { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 50; }

name: Visually hidden (sr-only)
summary: Hide text visually but keep it for screen readers.
example: .sr-only { position:absolute; width:1px; height:1px; padding:0; margin:-1px; overflow:hidden; clip:rect(0,0,0,0); white-space:nowrap; border:0; }

name: Tailwind CDN
summary: Use Tailwind without a build step (prototype use).
example: ...

name: Units: rem, em, %, vw, ch
summary: rem = root font size (accessible scaling); ch for readable line length.
example:
p { max-width: 65ch; line-height: 1.6; }
h2 { margin-block: 2rem 1rem; }

name: Logical properties
summary: margin-inline / padding-block work for right-to-left languages.
example: .card { padding-block: 1rem; padding-inline: 1.25rem; margin-inline: auto; }

name: querySelector / querySelectorAll
summary: Find elements with CSS selectors.

name: addEventListener
summary: React to clicks, input, keys. Use event delegation for lists.

name: classList / dataset
summary: Toggle classes and read data-* attributes.
example:
el.classList.toggle("open", isOpen);
const id = el.dataset.productId; // data-product-id

name: Mobile menu toggle
summary: Accessible hamburger menu.

name: Dark mode toggle
summary: Remember the choice and apply it before first paint.
example:
<script>/* in <head> */document.documentElement.dataset.theme = localStorage.theme || (matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches ? "dark" : "light");</script>
button.onclick = () => { const t = document.documentElement.dataset.theme === "dark" ? "light" : "dark"; document.documentElement.dataset.theme = t; localStorage.theme = t; };

name: fetch()
summary: HTTP requests; check response.ok.

name: async / await + try/catch
summary: Readable async code with error handling.

name: localStorage
summary: Persist small strings per site.
example:
localStorage.setItem("cart", JSON.stringify(cart));
const cart = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("cart") ?? "[]");

name: Form handling
summary: Read and validate a form without reloading.

name: IntersectionObserver
summary: Reveal-on-scroll and lazy loading without scroll listeners.

name: template literals and innerHTML
summary: Build markup from data; escape user text to avoid XSS.
example:
list.innerHTML = items.map((i) => `
  • ${escapeHtml(i.name)}
    • `).join(""); const escapeHtml = (s) => s.replace(/[&<>"]/g, (c) => ({"&":"&","<":"<",">":">","\"":"""}[c]));

name: createElement / append
summary: Build DOM safely (no HTML parsing).

name: Array methods
summary: map, filter, reduce, find, some, sort.
example:
const total = cart.reduce((sum, i) => sum + i.price * i.qty, 0);
const veg = menu.filter((m) => m.veg).map((m) => m.name);

name: Modules (import/export)
summary: Split code into files with <script type=module>.

name: setTimeout / debounce
summary: Delay or throttle work (e.g. search as you type).
example:
const debounce = (fn, ms = 250) => { let t; return (...a) => { clearTimeout(t); t = setTimeout(() => fn(...a), ms); }; };
input.addEventListener("input", debounce(search));

name: requestAnimationFrame
summary: Smooth animation tied to the display refresh.
example:
function tick(t) { el.style.transform = `translateX(${Math.sin(t / 500) * 20}px)`; requestAnimationFrame(tick); }
requestAnimationFrame(tick);

name: Date and Intl formatting
summary: Format prices, dates and numbers for the user's locale.
example:
new Intl.NumberFormat("pt-PT", { style: "currency", currency: "EUR" }).format(3.5);
new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en", { dateStyle: "medium" }).format(new Date());

name: Clipboard and share
summary: Copy text; open the phone share sheet.
example:
await navigator.clipboard.writeText(location.href);
if (navigator.share) await navigator.share({ title: document.title, url: location.href });

name: Geolocation
summary: Ask for the user's location (needs https and permission).
example: navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition((p) => console.log(p.coords.latitude, p.coords.longitude), (err) => console.warn(err.message));

name: Canvas 2D
summary: Draw graphics and simple games.

name: Common errors
summary: What frequent console errors mean.
example:
"Cannot read properties of null" -> querySelector found nothing (wrong selector, or script ran before the HTML: use defer).
"is not defined" -> typo or missing import.
"Failed to fetch" -> network/CORS; file:// pages cannot fetch other files in some browsers.

name: Service worker (offline)
summary: Cache files so a site works offline.
